Read packages/functions/CLAUDE.md and relevant .claude/skills first. These are VERIFIED findings from the 2026-10-14 security audit (verified read-only on origin/master 7152438ee2).
1. packages/functions/src/helpers/trello/addCardToTrello.js:4-8 hardcodes TRELLO_API_KEY / TRELLO_API_TOKEN (and list id) and builds them into the URL query (:17). Called from services/subscriptionService.js:857 on every US plan change. Read them from env (process.env.TRELLO_API_KEY, TRELLO_API_TOKEN, TRELLO_LIST_ID — follow how other env config is read in config/*.js); when missing, log a warn and return without throwing (plan change must never fail because of Trello). Pass params via axios `params` so name/desc are encoded. Remove the literals entirely.
2. Delete packages/functions/src/commands/testAuth.js (unused dev example; hardcodes a Google OAuth client secret). Confirm with git grep it's imported nowhere.
3. packages/functions/src/controllers/googleController.js:64,114,215,267 and helpers/google.js:51 log the whole googleapis/gaxios error object (`logger.error(..., e.message, e)`). gaxios 4.3.3 keeps config.headers.Authorization and, on token refresh, config.data with refresh_token/client_secret. Log only e.message, e.code and e.response?.status. Grep packages/functions/src for other `logger.*(…, e)` where e can be a GaxiosError from googleapis calls and fix those too.

Instead strip them on the REQUEST path only: in the shop controller(s) that take a merchant body (POST /shop and any sibling like PUT /shop), drop these keys (and dotted paths starting with them) unless the caller is privileged/DevZone (reuse the existing privileged/isTrustedWriter mechanism). Put the list in config/pickFields.js next to blockFields with a one-line why. First grep packages/assets/src for any FE code that legitimately POSTs one of these keys from a merchant (non-DevZone) screen; if one exists, keep it working via the DevZone/privileged path or report it.
2. POST /api/settings (seoController.js:289,296,344, getSettingsToSave in syncStructuredSetting.js:324-327) persists *.isDevZoneEnabled from the body. Strip any `isDevZoneEnabled` key at any depth unless canAccessDevZone(ctx.state.user) (find the existing helper). Same handler writes ?appStatus= / ?isSubscribed= query params onto the shop doc (:331-335) — check what legit caller sends them; if none from merchant UI, restrict to DevZone.
3. /api/dev/* has no router-level gate (routes/api.js:75; handlers/api.js:69). devChecklistTimelineController (getStuck returns other tenants' shopIds), devOptimizeTimelineController (?historyId read across shops, :52,62 → historyOptimizeRepository.js:206), devOptimizeJobController, gsdAutoFillController have no DevZone check. Add one router-level middleware for /dev that calls the existing DevZone access check (same one devController uses) and 403s otherwise; before adding, confirm every /dev route's legit caller is DevZone/internal (grep FE). Also check history.shopId === current shop in the optimize-timeline handler.
